vat_rates.legal_product_description: Standard rate of Value-Added Tax on the supply of all taxable goods and services, and on the importation of goods.
vat_rates.normalized_product_description: standard rate of value-added tax on the supply of all taxable goods and services, and on the importation of goods.
vat_rates.legal_reference: Nigeria Tax Act, 2025 (Act No. 7 of 2025), Section 147: "Subject to the provisions of Part IX of this Chapter, VAT shall be charged on the value of all taxable supplies at the rate of 7.5%."

vat_rates.legal_product_description: Standard rate of Value-Added Tax under the former Value Added Tax Act, Cap V1 LFN 2004 (as amended by the Finance Act 2019).
vat_rates.normalized_product_description: standard rate of value-added tax under the former value added tax act, cap v1 lfn 2004 (as amended by the finance act 2019).
vat_rates.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, Cap V1 LFN 2004, as amended by the Finance Act 2019 (rate raised from 5% to 7.5%, effective 1 February 2020). Repealed by the Nigeria Tax Act, 2025 (Act No. 7), effective 1 January 2026.
